questions.prompt: Which command creates an offer for the 'db' endpoint of an application named 'postgres'?
questions.explanation: 'juju offer <app>:<endpoint>' publishes an application endpoint so it can be consumed across models.

questions.prompt: How do you consume an offer created in model 'infra' named 'db-offer' into your current model?
questions.explanation: 'juju consume <model>.<offer-name>' adds the remote offer as a local proxy in the consumer model.

questions.prompt: Which command lists all active offers available in the current controller/model?
questions.explanation: 'juju list-offers' (or 'juju offers') lists all published application offers.
